newsitem.title: USA: Genesis agrees to sell unit.
newsitem.headline: Genesis agrees to sell unit.

text.p: Genesis International Financial Services Inc said Friday it reached an agreement in principal with an international investment group led by Suisse Private Banking Ltd and InterFinance Banking Group, representing a group of European and Arabic investors, to sell its major operating unit CRIC for $117 million.

Genesis will emerge out of the CRIC sale retaining ownership of the Miller Mountain Gold Mining operation, Guarantee Settlement Corp Inc and Longhorn Energy Corp Inc, presently held by CRIC, Genesis said.
The control and ownership of other Genesis subsidiaries will not be affected, Genesis said.

The transaction will be structured around a fully collateralized international promissory note, a long term consulting contract, and an international security agreement bonded by a major European carrier, Genesis said.
The parties have entered into a commitment to close the transaction within 45 days, Genesis said.

The deal, when closed on scheduled, will begin generating income for Genesis in the second quarter, adding over $0.43 per share to its bottom line in 1997 and over $0.58 cents per share for the nine years thereafter, Genesis said.
